title: 第1章 大隐于朝
content_zh:
哈密绥靖公署内院中，一个十四岁的小女孩蹦蹦跳跳走向书房。她正是绥署旅长崔博华之女崔莹。

    上午，老师方静刚刚讲完了《水浒传》中“武松打虎”的一段故事，午后本没有功课，但是崔莹兴犹未尽，仍缠着方老师再讲些梁山好汉的故事。

    这天烈日当空，四下静悄悄的，更没一丝凉风。崔莹来到书房外，怕老师午睡未醒，便蹑手蹑脚绕到窗外，踮起脚尖往里面望去。

    只见方静盘膝坐在椅子上，脸露微笑，右手向空中微微一扬，轻轻一声响，好似是什么东西在墙上一碰。她向墙上一看，只见对面墙上伏着几十只蚊虫，一动也不动。崔莹十分奇怪，凝神注视，只见每只蚊虫背上都钉着一枚细如头发的金针。金针极细，隔了这样远本来难以辨认，只因此时日光微斜，射进窗户来，金针在阳光下灿灿然生出了反光。

    书房中仍有蚊虫嗡嗡着飞来飞去，方静手一扬，又是一只蚊虫被钉在了墙上。崔莹觉得这把戏好玩，转到门口，推门进去，叫道：“方老师，您教我！”

    方静是位女硕士，戴着一副眼镜，大约四十来岁年纪，平时和崔莹虽然师生情厚，却从未显露功夫，这日发芙蓉金针却被崔莹在窗外看到了。她见崔莹那清秀明艳的脸蛋红扑扑的，显得格外兴奋与好奇，当下淡淡问：“你怎么没跟小伙伴去玩？”崔莹说：“方老师，我要学这好玩的把戏。”方静问：“什么把戏呀？”

    崔莹说：“用金针钉蚊虫的把戏。”说着搬了张椅子，爬了上去，细细瞧了瞧，把钉在蚊虫身上的金针一枚枚拔了下来，用纸巾擦干净，还给了方静，说道：“方老师，我知道，这不是把戏，是非常高明的武功。您非教我不可！”她曾跟随父亲在训练场骑马射击，也学过一些军体武艺。方静笑着说：“你想学武功呀？那也容易。哈密谁及得上你父亲啊？”崔莹说：“我父亲只会用枪打鸟、用箭射雕，可不会用金针钉蚊虫。”

    方静微微沉吟，知道这个女学生聪明伶俐，从小给父母宠坏了，行事多少有点任性，可不好糊弄，于是点头说：“好吧，明天早上你过来，我教你。现在你自己去玩吧。金针钉蚊虫的事情可不许对别人说。不论谁知道了，我就不教你啦。”

    崔莹果真不对人提起，整晚就想着这件事。第二天一早就到了书房，推开门来，不见方老师，只见书桌上压着一张纸条，拿起来一看，只见上面写着：

    小莹：汝心灵性敏，好学善问。得徒如此，夫复何憾。然汝有立雪之心，愚无时雨之化。三载滥竽，愧无教益。缘尽于此，后会有期。汝智变有余，而端凝不足。古云福慧双修，日后安身立命之道，其在修心积德也。愚方静字。

    崔莹拿了纸条，怔怔说不出话来，泪珠已在眼眶滴溜溜打转，心中只说：“老师骗人！”

    便在此时，忽然房门推开，跌跌撞撞走进一个人来，正是那位已经留书作别的方老师。但见她脸色惨白，上半身满是血污，进门来，摇摇欲坠，扶住椅子，晃了两晃，便倒在椅上。崔莹惊叫：“方老师！”方静说了声：“关上门，别做声！”就闭上眼不言语了。

    崔莹究是将门之女，虽然惊慌，还是依言关上了门。
content_en:
In the inner courtyard of the Hami Appeasement Office, a fourteen-year-old girl skipped towards the study. She is Cui Ying, the daughter of Cui Bohua, the brigade commander of Sui Department.

    In the morning, teacher Fang Jing had just finished telling the story of "Wu Song Fighting the Tiger" in "Water Margin". There was no homework in the afternoon, but Cui Ying was still excited and pestered Teacher Fang to tell more stories about Liangshan heroes.

    The sun was blazing in the sky that day, and it was quiet everywhere, not even a hint of cool breeze. Cui Ying came outside the study room, fearing that the teacher would not wake up from her nap, so she crept around the window and stood on tiptoes to look inside.

    Fang Jing was seen sitting cross-legged on a chair, with a smile on her face, her right hand slightly raised in the air, and there was a slight sound, as if something touched the wall. She looked towards the wall and saw dozens of mosquitoes lurking on the opposite wall, motionless. Cui Ying was very surprised. She watched carefully and saw a gold needle as thin as a hair nailed on the back of each mosquito. The golden needles were so thin that they were difficult to distinguish from such a distance, but because of the slightly slanted sunlight shining through the window, the golden needles reflected brilliantly in the sunlight.

    There were still mosquitoes buzzing and flying around in the study. Fang Jing raised her hand, and another mosquito was nailed to the wall. Cui Ying thought this trick was funny, so she turned to the door, pushed the door open and shouted, "Teacher Fang, please teach me!"

    Fang Jing is a female master's degree, wearing a pair of glasses. She is about forty years old. Although she and Cui Ying have a close teacher-student relationship, they have never shown any kung fu. However, Cui Ying saw her day-haired hibiscus and gold needles outside the window. Seeing Cui Ying's pretty and bright face flushed, she looked particularly excited and curious. She asked lightly: "Why didn't you go play with your friends?" Cui Ying said: "Teacher Fang, I want to learn this fun trick." Fang Jing asked: "What trick is it?"

    Cui Ying said: "The trick of nailing mosquitoes with gold needles." She moved a chair, climbed up, took a closer look, pulled out the gold needles nailed to the mosquitoes one by one, wiped them clean with paper towels, and gave them back to Fang Jing. She said, "Teacher Fang, I know this is not a trick, it is a very good martial arts. You have to teach me!" She once followed her father in riding and shooting at the training ground, and also learned some military martial arts. Fang Jing smiled and said, "You want to learn martial arts? That's easy. Who in Hami can match your father?" Cui Ying said, "My father can only shoot birds with a gun and shoot eagles with arrows, but he can't use gold needles to sting mosquitoes."

    Fang Jing pondered slightly, knowing that this female student was very smart and had been spoiled by her parents since she was a child. She acted somewhat willfully and could not be fooled, so she nodded and said, "Okay, come here tomorrow morning and I will teach you. Now you can go and play by yourself. Don't tell others about the mosquito sting with golden needles. No matter who knows, I won't teach you."

    Cui Ying really didn't mention it to anyone and thought about it all night. I arrived at the study early the next morning and opened the door. Teacher Fang was not there, but there was a piece of paper on the desk. I picked it up and saw that it read:

    Xiaoying: You have a sensitive mind and are eager to learn and ask questions. If you get a disciple like this, why would you regret it? However, you have the heart to stand up for the snow, but you are too stupid to be transformed by the rain. I have been playing Yu for three years, but I feel that I have learned nothing. The fate is here, see you later. You have more than enough wisdom to change, but not enough concentration. It is said in ancient times that cultivating both blessing and wisdom is the way to settle down and establish a good life in the future. It lies in cultivating the mind and accumulating virtue. Yufangjingzi.

    Cui Ying took the note and was speechless. Tears were already rolling in her eyes. She only said in her heart: "Teacher is lying!"

    At this moment, the door suddenly opened and a person stumbled in. It was Teacher Fang who had left a farewell letter. But when I saw her face was pale and her upper body was covered in blood, she came in, staggering, held on to the chair, shook it twice, and then fell down on the chair. Cui Ying exclaimed: "Teacher Fang!" Fang Jing said: "Close the door and be silent!" She closed her eyes and said nothing.

    Cui Ying was the daughter of the general after all. Although she was panicked, she still closed the door as instructed.
title_en: Chapter 1 Hidden away from the court
